'''Peter Behr''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Geneva tournament]] on 2 September 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|ROPS]] and Throne Room Mains, according to Paul Motz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1185">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-02-geneva-illinois-9-2-00d1185/ geneva-illinois-9-2-00], DeckTech (Paul "Vollerian" Motz, 2 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-02-geneva-illinois-9-2-00d1185/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
